name: lemmatize
description:
Each word of a phrase replaced by its lemma, in lower case.

fallback: for a word missing from the bundled dictionary. Not given: the word goes to pymorphy3 if its dictionary knows the word, else to the suffix rule, and often stays as it is («тиктокерами»); "pymorphy": such a word takes the best guess of pymorphy3 («тиктокерами» → «тиктокер»).

Example: semkit read --text "купила диваны" lemmatize write -
-> купить диван

The step rewrites the working column; with --as NAME it writes the result to a new column NAME.

options.name: --fallback
options.description: for a word missing from the bundled dictionary. Not given: the word goes to pymorphy3 if its dictionary knows the word, else to the suffix rule, and often stays as it is («тиктокерами»); "pymorphy": such a word takes the best guess of pymorphy3 («тиктокерами» → «тиктокер»).

options.name: --as
options.description: Write the result to a new column NAME and keep the working column as it is.
